title: Closed top-degree currents annihilate (D_j a) dx¹∧⋯∧dxⁿ (Step 2 of Simon 2.34)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n = m + 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ an arbitrary set and T ∈ D_n(U) (a GeometricCurrentOn U n) with ∂T = 0. If a : ℝⁿ → ℝ is C^∞ with compact support and spt a ⊆ U, j ∈ {1,…,n}, and ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) satisfies ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) = D_j a(x) for every x ∈ ℝⁿ (i.e. ω = (D_j a) dx¹∧⋯∧dxⁿ), then T(ω) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), T.boundary = 0 → ∀ (a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ U → ∀ (j : Fin (m + 1)) (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), (∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) → T ω = 0
